title: Structural Claims Schedule for New Home Builder Warranties
content:
The structural claims schedule lists, for every program of Bridgewell's New Home Builder Warranties, the figures and settings that apply to a structural claim: the homeowner's deductible, the limit on structural payments, the living expense allowance, the evaluation period and the program's structural settings.

## Amounts and periods

| Program | Structural deductible | Structural limit over the warranty's life, as a fraction of the final sale price | Living expense allowance (lodging and storage when the home must be vacated) | Determination issued within |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Structural-Only Ten-Year Warranty | 250.00 USD | 1.00 | 0.00 USD | 30 calendar days after filing |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty | 250.00 USD | 1.00 | 2000.00 USD | 30 calendar days after filing |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Appliances | 250.00 USD | 1.00 | 2000.00 USD | 30 calendar days after filing |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Attached Home Warranty | 250.00 USD | 1.00 | 2000.00 USD | 30 calendar days after filing |
| Bridgewell 1-2-10 Builder Warranty with Systems Extension | 250.00 USD | 1.00 | 2000.00 USD | 30 calendar days after filing |
| Bridgewell 2-4-10 Premier Builder Warranty | 0.00 USD | 1.00 | 3500.00 USD | 30 calendar days after filing |

A limit fraction of 1.00 means structural payments over the warranty's life may reach the full final sale price.

## Structural settings

Every one of the six programs carries the same settings:

| Setting | All six programs |
|---|---|
| Bridgewell may pay the reasonable cost of repair in cash instead of repairing | Yes |
| The engineering inspection of a structural claim is at Bridgewell's cost | Yes |
| A structural determination requires an engineer's evaluation | Yes |
| Structural damage caused by soil movement is covered | Yes |
| The structural deductible is charged only once over the warranty's life | Yes |
| A structural repair is itself warranted through the end of the structural period | Yes |

## Load-bearing elements

Every program lists the same load-bearing elements whose actual physical damage is a structural defect:

- foundation systems and footings
- beams
- girders
- lintels
- columns
- load-bearing walls and partitions
- roof framing systems
- floor systems

## Points of comparison

**Where does the Premier program differ?** The Bridgewell 2-4-10 Premier Builder Warranty has a structural deductible of 0.00 USD and a living expense allowance of 3500.00 USD.

**Which program pays no living expenses?** The Bridgewell Structural-Only Ten-Year Warranty, whose allowance is 0.00 USD.

**Hypothetical illustration of the limit.** For a home with a final sale price of 480000.00 dollars under any program, a limit fraction of 1.00 sets the life-of-warranty structural limit at 480000.00 dollars.
